plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: Language-agnostic coding-agent configuration for OpenCode and Kilo-compatible runtimes. Ships a router AGENTS.md encoding repo-as-record doctrine, six on-demand skills (commit-message, effective-code-craft, harness-engineering, performance-patterns, repo-documentation, spec-driven-development), five slash commands (document-phase, judge-phase, refactor-phase, review-phase, verify-phase), and a primary conductor orchestrator that drives the think/act/prove loop. Targets deterministic, executable-completion workflows over speculative AI assistance.
